Figure caption: Nuclei tagging is an effective screening strategy for LNP biodistribution studies(A) Cre mRNA-LNP delivery reporting in a nuclear sfGFP mouse model. Nuclear sfGFP expression remains stable after snap freezing and thawing of tissue. (B) Nuclei are sorted using fluorescence-activated nuclei sorting. Nuclei are gated for size, single cells, and DAPI. (C) Characterization of LNP library. (D) Quantification of long-term functional mRNA delivery in the liver of sfGFP reporter fetal (E14), neonatal (P0) and adult (AD) recipients n = 3–6 per group. (E) IHC validation of sfGFP+ nuclei in the liver of fetal and adult LNP1 recipients. ∗p < 0.05; data are expressed as mean ± SEM; n = 3–6.

Figure caption: Fetal LNP administration facilitates functional mRNA delivery to microglia and neurons in the CNS parenchyma(A) DAPI+ nuclei are gated for cell-type-specific markers of neurons (Neun), endothelial nuclei (Erg), and microglia (Pu.1). (B) Validation of cell-type-specific markers using fluorescence minus one (FMO) controls. (C) Percentage of sfGFP+ endothelial nuclei, microglia, and neurons in the cortex following administration of LNP1, 2, or 3 at fetal (E14), neonatal (P0) and adult (AD) developmental stages. (D) IHC validation of sfGFP+ nuclei in the cerebellum of fetal recipient of LNP1. (E) Percentage of sfGFP+ endothelial nuclei, microglia, and neurons in the spinal cord following systemic injections of LNP1, 2, or 3 at fetal, neonatal, and adult developmental stages. (F) IHC validation of sfGFP+ nuclei in the spinal cord of fetal LNP1 recipients. Data analysis was performed by two-way ANOVA with Tukey’s multiple comparison test. ∗p < 0.05; data are expressed as mean ± SEM; n = 3–6.

Figure caption: ABE8.8 mRNA and gRNA_A36G encapsulated in LNP1 mediates on-target A36G editing in normal HEK293T and SMA-patient-derived fibroblast cells(A) Map of human SMN2 sequence denoted with on-target A-to-G editing at site A36 (blue text), bystander editing at site A38 (gray text), and guide RNA overlap. SMN2 exon 7 is highlighted in yellow. (B) Comparison of on-target and bystander A-to-G editing in HEK293 cells using nucleofection of ABE8.8 or ABE 8e mRNA paired with gRNA_A36G. (C) On-target A-to-G editing dose-response curve at SMN2 locus using LNP1 encapsulating ABE8.8 mRNA and gRNA_A36G in HEK293 cells. (D) On-target A-to-G editing dose-response curve at SMN2 locus using LNP1 encapsulating ABE8.8 mRNA and gRNA_A36G in SMA patient fibroblasts. Dose indicates total RNA (ABE8.8 mRNA and gRNA_A36G at 1:1 ratio). (E) Quantification of full-length SMN mRNA in LNP-treated SMA patient fibroblasts using ddPCR. (F) Quantification of SMN protein levels in SMA patient fibroblasts by ELISA. (G) Quantification of SMN protein levels in SMA patient fibroblasts by western blot. Data analysis was performed by one-way ANOVA with Dunnett’s multiple comparison test. ∗p < 0.05; data are expressed as mean ± SEM; n = 3–5.

Figure caption: ABE8.8 mRNA and gRNA_A36G encapsulated in LNP1 mediates on-target A36G editing in an SMA mouse model(A) Quantification of A-to-G editing in the liver of severe SMA mice. (B) Quantification of full-length SMN mRNA in the liver of severe SMA mice. (C) Quantification of SMN protein levels in the liver of severe SMA mice. (D) Quantification of A-to-G editing in the cortex of severe SMA mice. (E) Quantification of full-length SMN mRNA in the cortex of severe SMA mice. (F) Quantification of SMN protein levels in the cortex of severe SMA mice. (G) Quantification of A-to-G editing in the spinal cord of severe SMA mice. (H) Quantification of full-length SMN mRNA in the spinal cord of severe SMA mice. (I) Quantification of SMN protein levels in the spinal cord of severe SMA mice. LNP1 encapsulating ABE 8.8 mRNA alone (−gRNA) or LNP1 encapsulating ABE 8.8 mRNA and gRNA_A36G (+gRNA). Dose indicates total RNA (ABE8.8 mRNA and gRNA_A36G 1:1 ratio). Mice were intravenously administered LNP at E14 (fetal) or P0 (neonatal). Data analysis was performed by two-way ANOVA with Tukey’s multiple comparison test. ∗p < 0.05; data are expressed as mean ± SEM; n = 2–5.

Figure caption: Fetal administration of ABE8.8 mRNA and gRNA_A36G LNPs improves survival in an SMA mouse modelQuantification of (A) weight gain and (B) survival in severe SMA mice treated with LNP1 encapsulating ABE8.8 mRNA alone (−gRNA) or LNP1 encapsulating ABE8.8 mRNA and gRNA_A36G (+gRNA). Data analysis was performed by (A) two-way repeated measures ANOVA with Tukey’s multiple comparison test and (B) Kaplan-Meier analysis. Asterix compares E14 + gRNA_A36G LNP1-injected severe SMA mice to all other groups. Dose indicates total RNA (ABE8.8 mRNA and gRNA_A36G 1:1 ratio). ∗p < 0.05; data are expressed as mean ± SEM; n = 3–5.
